---- MODULE FlashWithMutex ----
EXTENDS FlashWithMutexDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL PL == INSTANCE TLAPS

NodeFairness(n) ==
 /\ WF_vars(HandleUni(n))
 /\ WF_vars(HandleInv(n))
 /\ WF_vars(NI_Replace(n))
WbDone == WbMsg.Cmd = "WB_None"
NakcDone == NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_None"
ShWbDone == ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_None"
RpDone(n) == RpMsg[n].Cmd = "RP_None"
InvDone(n) == InvMsg[n].Cmd = "INV_None"
InvSent(n) == InvMsg[n].Cmd = "INV_Inv"
InvAcked(n) == InvMsg[n].Cmd = "INV_InvAck"
InvChannelType == InvMsg \in [NODE -> [Cmd : INV_CMD]]

LEMMA NodeFairnessAll == FairSpec => \A n \in NODE : NodeFairness(n)
BY PL!PTL DEF FairSpec, Fairness, NodeFairness

\* The memory field is DATA-valued, even though unused payload fields may
\* contain Undefined.  These validity implications close the type induction.
DataValid ==
 /\ \A p \in NODE : Proc[p].CacheState \in {"CACHE_S", "CACHE_E"}
                       => Proc[p].CacheData \in DATA
 /\ \A p \in NODE : UniMsg[p].Cmd \in {"UNI_Put", "UNI_PutX"}
                       => UniMsg[p].Data \in DATA
 /\ WbMsg.Cmd = "WB_Wb" => WbMsg.Data \in DATA
 /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_ShWb" => ShWbMsg.Data \in DATA
 /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd \in {"SHWB_ShWb", "SHWB_FAck"} => ShWbMsg.Proc \in NODE

StrongType == TypeOK /\ DataValid

LEMMA StrongTypeInit == Init => StrongType

\* A pending directory transaction has one control token: a forwarded
\* request, a home reply, a control message, or an invalidation collection.
\* Pairing requests with processor commands prevents request overwrites.
Forwarding(p) == UniMsg[p].Cmd \in {"UNI_Get", "UNI_GetX"} /\ UniMsg[p].Proc # Home
HomeReply == UniMsg[Home].Cmd \in {"UNI_Put", "UNI_PutX"}
ControlPair == \A p \in NODE :
 /\ (Proc[p].ProcCmd = "NODE_None" <=> UniMsg[p].Cmd = "UNI_None")
 /\ (UniMsg[p].Cmd \in {"UNI_Get", "UNI_Put"} => Proc[p].ProcCmd = "NODE_Get")
 /\ (UniMsg[p].Cmd \in {"UNI_GetX", "UNI_PutX"} => Proc[p].ProcCmd = "NODE_GetX")
 /\ (Proc[p].ProcCmd # "NODE_None" => Proc[p].CacheState # "CACHE_E")
 /\ (UniMsg[p].Cmd \in {"UNI_Get", "UNI_GetX"} => UniMsg[p].Proc \in NODE \ {p})
ControlDir ==
 /\ (Dir.Dirty /\ Dir.Local => Proc[Home].CacheState = "CACHE_E")
 /\ (Dir.Dirty /\ ~Dir.Local => Dir.HeadPtr \in NODE \ {Home})
 /\ (ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_None" => ShWbMsg.Proc \in NODE \ {Home})
ControlInv ==
 /\ InvMsg[Home].Cmd = "INV_None"
 /\ \A p \in NODE : InvMsg[p].Cmd # "INV_None" => Collecting /\ p \in Dir.InvSet
 /\ Collecting => /\ ~Dir.ShrVld
                  /\ Dir.InvSet = {p \in NODE : InvMsg[p].Cmd # "INV_None"}

 /\ (Dir.Pending <=> ((\E p \in NODE : Forwarding(p)) \/ HomeReply \/
                      NakcMsg.Cmd # "NAKC_None" \/ ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_None" \/ Collecting))
 /\ \A p \in NODE : Forwarding(p) =>
      /\ Dir.Pending /\ ~Dir.Local /\ PendReqSrc = p /\ FwdCmd = UniMsg[p].Cmd
      /\ ~Collecting /\ NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_None" /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_None"
      /\ ~HomeReply
 /\ HomeReply => /\ ~Collecting /\ NakcMsg.Cmd = "NAKC_None" /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_None"
 /\ NakcMsg.Cmd # "NAKC_None" => /\ ~Collecting /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd = "SHWB_None"
 /\ ShWbMsg.Cmd # "SHWB_None" => ~Collecting
ControlState == ControlPair /\ ControlDir /\ ControlInv /\ ControlMutex
